# Security policy

Rescue Router is research code: a static web viewer (no server, no accounts, no data collection; an uploaded photo is
processed inside the browser and never sent anywhere) and Python scripts that run locally.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report it privately through GitHub: **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository. Do not open a
public issue. You can expect a first reply within a week.

Relevant reports include anything that lets the viewer run code from a crafted link or image, or that sends a user's
photo or data off their device.

## Supported versions

Only the latest commit on `main`, which is what the live viewer serves.
